title: Field Workforce Geofenced Attendance & Site Audit Router
name: Field Workforce Geofenced Attendance & Site Audit Router
user_prompt: Create a field workforce geofenced attendance check-in and multi-site store audit planner centered in Austin. Render an interactive Google Map showing pre-seeded client site geofence polygons and a drawing toolbar (using Terra Draw) allowing supervisors to draw new polygon geofence zones. Provide a simulated worker GPS position selector (with presets inside and outside an active geofence) that detects polygon entry/exit states, reverse-geocodes the worker's current street address, and enables or locks the 'Verified Clock-In' badge accordingly. Also compute and render an optimized multi-stop driving route connecting the day's assigned audit sites using the Routes API with waypoint optimization.
